subject.title: fix: stabilize OpenClaw beta setup and PT-PT formatting

question: Should the Companion advance its default OpenClaw LKG to 2026.7.1 before current-head real setup E2E passes against that official release?
rationale: The repository requires real Gateway-path proof, while the canonical tracking issue documents fresh-start failures for the selected release; choosing release alignment over a working default requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Wait for passing setup E2E
options.body: Keep the version bump out until official 2026.7.1 completes the real Companion setup path successfully.

options.title: Split the safe changes
options.body: Land invariant formatting and independently proven lifecycle fixes separately while retaining the current setup-proven LKG.

options.title: Accept the release risk
options.body: Advance to 2026.7.1 despite the known setup blocker and explicitly own the fresh-install failure mode.

recommendation.title: Wait for passing setup E2E
recommendation.body: Keep the version bump out until official 2026.7.1 completes the real Companion setup path successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: They co-introduced the onboarding flow and recently maintained wizard behavior, making them the strongest available owner for the release-gate choice.
